changes.before: Amends the MLUL to require planning boards to submit certain data center applications to the State Planning Commission and BPU; requires State Planning Commission approval; excludes data centers from economic development subsidies.
changes.after: Introduced MLUL proposal sends completed preliminary site-plan/major-subdivision applications to SPC and BPU. SPC, consulting BPU, has 45 days from planning-board submission to approve or deny; silence deems SPC approval, not all municipal approvals. Developer pays review costs. Excludes State-public-body economic-development subsidies over $25,000, with unsubsidized procurement excluded; applies to applications submitted on/after proposed effectiveness.

changes.before: Requires BPU approval of energy usage plans for proposed AI data centers and cryptocurrency mining facilities; requires electricity from new clean energy sources after a PJM-region trigger is met.
changes.after: Officially designated companions have differing displayed synopses: S680 includes AI centers and cryptocurrency mining; reviewed A1170 introduced text covers AI centers. In A1170, a published BPU finding that most PJM states implement specified supply/no-net-decrease requirements triggers both plan submission with the local application and supply from new verifiable Class I renewables and/or nuclear power without net decrease of those sources. Separate section 3(d) bars connection without approval of a section 3(b) plan; trigger interaction is not independently resolved. BPU decision: 90 days; resubmission after disapproval: 30 days. No finding, implementation or final-text equality established.
